name: Moe’s Valley climbing parking at the end of the paved road
basis: Moe’s Valley area Getting There: use the mapped Moe’s Valley climbing parking area; low-clearance cars park where concrete turns to dirt. Brief lot is named Moe’s Valley Climbing Parking and sits 0.3 km from the area.

name: Chuckawalla trailhead lot on Hwy 18 (Snow Canyon day-use fee)
basis: Turtle Wall Getting There: start from the well-signed Chuckwalla parking lot about a mile north of St. George on Hwy 18; lot now charges a Snow Canyon State Park day fee. Matches brief lot named Chuckawalla Trail Head (fee yes).

name: Pioneer Names trailhead pullout on the Snow Canyon scenic drive
basis: Circus Wall/Aftershock (Island in the Sky) Getting There: park at the well-marked Pioneer Names trail pullout on the right past the West Canyon day-use area. Brief lot named Pioneer Names Trailhead Parking is 0.2 km from the area.

name: Cougar Cliffs pullout on the west side of Hwy 18
basis: Cougar Cliffs description: drive north on Bluff St (becomes UT 18) just under four miles; park at the climbing area on the left and walk down to the crags. Only unnamed brief lot along Hwy 18 near the crag (0.86 km); match by position.

name: Cove Wash trailhead at the end of the pavement above Gates Lane
basis: Cove Wash Getting There: Gates Lane in Santa Clara to end of pavement then gravel road to the clearings by Cove Wash trailhead; BLM directions park at the Cove Wash trailhead. Brief lot named Cove Wash Trail Head is 0.77 km away; the climbers’ clearing is slightly farther up the road.
